about: The workspace's event catalog: every log line is one of these events, its id and values only; the sentence is the template here. Addresses are those of the traced program's file, in hex; values print in hex, floats in decimal, a value of no printable type as ?.

fields.a: its arguments, in order (absent when it takes none)

fields.c: the callee, by address or import name
the import, as DLL!NAME; a DirectDraw method, reached through a table and no import, as INTERFACE::NAME
fields.a: its arguments, in order (absent when it takes none); the file and registry calls' seams log their numbers alone, never a pointer; a window, input or drawing call's numbers alone too, a record it is handed (a message, a rectangle, a point, a class) as its fields comma-joined, never its address, a null rectangle none; a DirectDraw Blt's two rectangles each after a 0 or 1 saying it was handed, zeros for a null, as its fill colour is a number, 0 with no effects record
fields.h: the heap the block came from or goes to: the C library's memory helpers alone
fields.v: the value it returned (absent when void); a key-state input call's low 16 bits, the SHORT the caller reads
fields.p: the file name the call was given, as text: the file calls' seam alone
fields.m: the module name a process call was given or wrote, as text: the process calls' seam alone
fields.q: the entry name GetProcAddress was asked, as text
fields.s: other text a process or text call was given: an environment block or variable, a command line, a debug string, the bytes or units to convert, map or compare; the key path or value name a registry call was given; the class, icon or cursor name a window or input call was given, # and the number for an atom or a resource id below 0x10000, empty for null; a byte past printable ASCII as \xNN, a unit as \uNNNN
fields.with: the second text a compare call was given, shown as s shows the first; the default character WideCharToMultiByte was given, empty for null; the title or menu name a window call was given, shown as s shows the class
fields.o: what a drawing call wrote, as numbers (a bits pointer, a paint record), empty on a 0 answer; what a CD-audio call wrote, a number or its text; what a DirectDraw call wrote, its record or its out pointer, empty on any answer but DD_OK; what a text call wrote into its buffer, shown as s shows its text, its length the smaller of the value and the buffer: GetStringType's classes as hex words, comma-joined; GetCPInfo's 18-byte record as bytes; empty for no buffer or a 0 answer; what a registry call wrote or kept, its numbers comma-joined: the handle an open wrote, the handle and disposition a create wrote, the type, size and value a query wrote (the value only with a buffer), the value a set kept; empty for a refusal that writes nothing; the record a window or input call wrote, its numbers comma-joined (a message's 7, a rectangle's 4, a point's 2), empty on a 0 answer
fields.r: the start-up record GetStartupInfoA wrote: its flags, show-window, reserved count and reserved address; the used-default flag WideCharToMultiByte wrote, empty for null
fields.to: the new name a move was given, as text
fields.n: the bytes a read or write moved, read from its out-pointer after the call
fields.found: the file name a find call found, empty when it found none
fields.e: the thread's last error as the file, process or text call left it, the value the file would read
fields.t: the instant a time call read: the wall clock's file-time ticks, or the game clock's microseconds
fields.w: the 8 date words a time call wrote: year, month, weekday, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond
fields.f: the file time a time call wrote
fields.from: the address the call returns to in the file that made it: the drawing, thread, process, text, registry, window and input calls' seams alone; 0 where a target has none
fields.by: who computed the answer the caller reads: the crate's name from a front, orig from the original; absent on a line that does not say yet

events.template: the layer's call to {c} with {a} returned {v}

fields.c: the folder call or track read the logical disc answered, by its method's name
fields.a: the handle or find it was given, or the track's number; 0 when it takes a name
fields.p: the name or pattern it was given, as text (a move's first); empty when it takes a handle
fields.v: its answer: the handle, find, count or position; 0 for a yes and on a failure
fields.n: the bytes a read moved off the disc; 0 for every other call
fields.e: the failure, by its name; ok on success

events.template: the disc's {c} of {a} {p} answered {v}, {n} bytes moved: {e}

fields.c: the drawing call the entries belong to, as DLL!NAME or INTERFACE::NAME
fields.a: up to 16 entries, each 32 bits as the caller's memory holds them

fields.n: how many presents the page has dropped so far, this one counted

events.template: the page replaced a present it had not read, {n} so far

fields.w: the window's width the picture was painted into

fields.c: the DirectDraw interface, by its SDK name
fields.i: the slot's offset in that interface's table, ddraw.h's on a 32-bit target

events.template: {c}'s slot at {i} has no front: answered unsupported

fields.refused: softbuffer's refusal, in place of a paint

fields.w: the box the player pressed a control of
fields.checked: whether the control is checked after the press flipped it; false for a control that takes no check and for an id the box lacks

events.template: the player pressed control {id} of box {w}, its check now {checked}

fields.w: the box whose own loop now runs

events.template: box {w} runs its own loop on the queue until EndDialog: it draws nothing, and sends its owner none of the messages Windows sends there

fields.c: its sound channels, 0 for no track

events.template: a clip opened, {w} by {h}, {f} frames of {t} microseconds, {c} channels
frame {i} painted from {n} bytes, palette {p}: {m} mono, {u} full, {s} solid, {v} void

fields.n: the samples it unpacked to, both channels counted

fields.p: the clip's file name as the caller asked for it, as text
fields.n: the bytes the back read, 0 for a file it lacks

fields.d: the instant that frame is due, in microseconds

events.template: frame {i} is due at {d}, the clock reads {t}
